data_output.description: data.py must preserve the existing encoded feature output and canonical row order, while returning primary long_view labels and impression-level is_like binary labels for training. Validation/test labels may remain available to the fixed evaluator but must not be used by training except for the existing within-user early-stop proxy. Unknown users/videos must retain the existing vocabulary and offset behavior. The output artifact must contain exactly row_ids and scores, where row_ids are contiguous canonical validation row indices and scores are finite one-dimensional long_view predictions.

model_input.description: model.py receives encoded user-video features plus long_view labels and is_like labels for training. It must retain additive user/item effects and the 16-dimensional user-video interaction representation, add an auxiliary sigmoid is_like head from the shared interaction representation, and optimize primary long_view BCE plus 0.1 times auxiliary is_like BCE. The primary long_view logit remains the only value returned by predict(); no auxiliary score may affect the artifact schema or evaluator input. Preserve the current Adam-style optimizer, learning rate, L2 behavior, checkpoint state handling, split, and within-user evaluation procedure.
